# FG-AGENT-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `moved_tag_after_publish_has_no_effect` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この部品のこの版はもう公開されています。公開した版は変えられません。版の番号を上げて、新しい tag を作ってください。
- en: This version of the part is already published, and a published version never changes. Raise the version number and make a new tag.
- id: Versi bagian ini sudah diterbitkan, dan versi yang sudah diterbitkan tidak pernah berubah. Naikkan nomor versi dan buat tag baru.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A5 (ADR-0032 Amendment A5, plan 16 §3): `POST /api/v1/agent-parts/{slug}/versions` named a version already in `forge.agent_part_versions` (unique (part, version)). A published version is frozen at publication — moving the tag afterwards changes nothing (`moved_tag_after_publish_has_no_effect`). `reason`: `version_exists`. Also `reason=kind_changed` / `source_changed` when the part's `part.toml` names another kind, or the tag is in another project, than the part's first version. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route's log event carries `slug`, `version`, `tag` and `request_id`; `gstn part view <slug>` lists the published versions with their source commit and digest.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: bump `version` in `part.toml`, merge it, tag `<slug>/v<new version>` and publish that tag.
